title: Just as He Had Always Done

request.style: English, classic soul, rich soulful female vocal, Rhodes electric piano, warm bass, horn section, soft backing vocals, steady and steadfast, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Taken from Jerusalem, a young man far from home
Babylon had golden halls and gods of wood and stone
They set the king's food on his table, poured the king's own wine
But Daniel resolved in his heart
Not to defile himself

[Chorus]
Three times a day he got down on his knees and prayed
Giving thanks to his God
Just as he had always done
Kings may rise and kings may fall
He kept on praying through it all

[Verse]
The king dreamed of a statue made of gold and iron and clay
A stone not cut by human hands came and broke it all away
Daniel blessed the God of heaven who knows what lies in the dark
He changes times and seasons
He removes kings and sets up kings

[Verse]
At Belshazzar's feast a hand wrote letters on the wall
The cups of gold were shaking and the king began to fall
You have been weighed on the scales and found too light
And the kingdom ended in the dark of that same night

[Chorus]
Three times a day he got down on his knees and prayed
Giving thanks to his God
Just as he had always done
Kings may rise and kings may fall
He kept on praying through it all

[Bridge]
They threw him in the lions' den and sealed it with a ring
And sleep fled from the palace, sleep fled from the king
At the first light of dawn the king got up and hurried to the lions' den
My God sent his angel and shut the mouths of the lions
